from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OtherReceivablesRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single extraction of 'Other Receivables' from a company's financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company whose document is being parsed")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the financial statement covers")
    other_receivables_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of 'Other Receivables' (其他应收款)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency in which the amount is denominated")
    quote: str = Field(description="The verbatim text or table cell containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    other_receivables_records: list[OtherReceivablesRecord]
